name: Corki
title: the Daring Bombardier

Q.name: Phosphorus Bomb
Q.description: Corki lobs a bomb, dealing 60/105/150/195/240 + 1.25×bonus AD + 1×AP magic damage. The area and champions hit are revealed for 6 seconds.
Q.summary: Corki fires a flash bomb at a target location, dealing magic damage to enemies in the area. This attack additionally reveals units in the area for a duration.

W.name: Valkyrie
W.description: Corki flies over and scorches a path, burning it for 2.5 seconds. Enemies in the fire take up to 150/225/300/375/450 + 1.5×AP + 2×bonus AD magic damage over the duration.
W.summary: Corki flies a short distance, dropping bombs that create a trail of fire that damages opponents who remain in it.

E.name: Gatling Gun
E.description: Corki fires a gatling gun in front of him, dealing 80/130/180/230/280 + 2.4×bonus AD physical damage over 4 seconds and shredding up to 12/14/16/18/20 Armor and Magic Resist.
E.summary: Corki's gatling gun rapidly fires in a cone in front of him, dealing damage and reducing enemy Armor and Magic Resist.

R.name: Missile Barrage
R.description: Corki fires a missile that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing 100/190/280 + 0.9×bonus AD physical damage to surrounding enemies. Every third missile instead deals (100/190/280 + 0.9×bonus AD) × 2 physical damage. This Ability has up to 4 charges. Basic attacks against champions reduce the time between charges by (1 + 2×crit) × 2 seconds on hit.
R.summary: Corki fires a missile toward his target location that explodes on impact, dealing damage to enemies in an area. Corki stores missiles over time, up to a maximum. Every 3rd missile fired will be a Big One, dealing extra damage.

Passive.name: Hextech Munitions
Passive.description: A percentage of Corki's basic attack damage is dealt as bonus true damage.
Passive.summary: A percentage of Corki's basic attack damage is dealt as bonus true damage.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Poke-heavy mage-marksman who chips with Q and R missiles and deals true damage on attacks. Every few minutes he picks up The Package for a long-range W engage.
strengths: Long-range R missile poke on a short cooldown
Passive turns part of his attack damage into true damage
E shreds armor and magic resist
W dash for escapes; Package W for engages
weaknesses: Weak level 1–3 against strong early laners
Short W is his only escape until Package
profile.curveNote: Trades mostly with Q/R poke; all-ins after first item.

Q.notes: Lobbed bomb; reveals area. Watch the landing circle.

W.notes: Dash leaving fire behind. Package version knocks back (not in description).

E.notes: Front-cone gatling; shreds resists over 4 s. Step out of the cone.

R.notes: Missile hits first enemy; every 3rd is bigger. Hide behind minions.

Passive.notes: Part of attack damage dealt as true damage.

profile.windowAgainst: Before 6 and when W is down: all-in, he can't escape.
checks: Package W knock-back not in description (not tagged)
